briefing: Markets rallied sharply today with NASDAQ +2.7% and S&P 500 +1.9%, a clear risk-on signal. Cash is low ($89.29) so we're deploying it into PFE, the top-scoring candidate with clean bullish signals and no overbought warning, while holding all 7 existing positions.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of buying just because RSI is overbought or a stock is jumping, look for several signals lining up together — like RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD crossover, and price above its moving average. When multiple independent signals agree, it's a stronger, more reliable buy setup than chasing a single overbought spike.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 買入決定不應只憑RSI超買或股價急升,而應觀察多個指標是否同時配合,例如RSI處於健康的偏好區間、MACD出現黃金交叉,以及股價高於平均線。當多個獨立訊號同時確認,買入訊號會比單純追逐超買急升股份更可靠。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today, with NASDAQ up 2.7% and the S&P 500 up 1.9%, points to a risk-on session where investors rotated into growth and momentum names. Most screened candidates are now showing overbought RSI readings above 70, suggesting the rally has been running hot across many sectors. PFE stands out with healthier, less-stretched technicals (RSI 61.5) rather than joining the overbought crowd.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好,納指升2.7%,標普500升1.9%,反映市場處於「risk-on」(風險偏好)氣氛,資金流向增長及動能股。不過篩選名單中大部分候選股RSI已升穿70,屬超買區,顯示今輪升浪部分股份已略為過熱。相對而言,輝瑞(PFE)技術指標較為健康(RSI 61.5),未見超買,故成為今日首選。

trades.reasoning: Strong risk-on day (NASDAQ +2.7%) plus PFE is the only candidate with full multi-signal confirmation (RSI 61.5 bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, price above SMA-20) rather than being overbought like most of the list.
